title: 拉德瑞洛地熱場現代化
summary: 義大利托斯卡尼的拉德瑞洛在 1904 年第一次用地熱蒸汽點亮電燈，1913 年建成世界第一座商用地熱電廠；今天這個地區有三十幾座電廠、九百 MW 上下的容量，供應托斯卡尼約三成的用電。課程以它的現代化為主軸，定量分析機組的蒸汽流量、輸汽管線的凝結量、硫化氫與汞的減排、岩石的蓄熱量，以及地熱在地區供電中的份量。
summaryEn: Larderello in Tuscany, Italy, first lit electric lamps with geothermal steam in 1904 and built the world's first commercial geothermal plant in 1913; today the area has over thirty plants and about nine hundred megawatts, supplying about three tenths of Tuscany's electricity. Built round its modernisation, the course quantifies steam flow of a unit, condensate in steam mains, abatement of hydrogen sulphide and mercury, heat stored in rock, and the weight of geothermal in regional supply.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 地熱發電的發源地一百二十年：蒸汽流量、管線凝結、減排、岩石蓄熱與地區供電
v30FocusEn: A hundred and twenty years at the birthplace of geothermal power: steam flow, pipeline condensate, abatement, heat in rock and regional supply

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：拉德瑞洛地熱場現代化
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Larderello Geothermal Field Modernization
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱源溫度與效率上限」與「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" and "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「熱源溫度與效率上限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" is correct?
options: 地熱是品位偏低的熱源：高溫熱儲約 200 至 350 °C，中低溫只有 100 至 180 °C。
地熱電廠效率只有一成多，所以是一種浪費的發電方式。
只要鑽得夠深，任何地方都能便宜地開發地熱發電。
optionsEn: Geothermal heat is of modest grade: high-temperature reservoirs are about 200–350 °C and medium to low ones only 100–180 °C.
Geothermal plants are only a little over 10% efficient, so they are a wasteful way to generate.
Drill deep enough and geothermal power can be developed cheaply anywhere.
quiz.explanation: 地熱是品位偏低的熱源：高溫熱儲約 200 至 350 °C，中低溫只有 100 至 180 °C。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Geothermal heat is of modest grade: high-temperature reservoirs are about 200–350 °C and medium to low ones only 100–180 °C. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與效率上限：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「熱源溫度與效率上限」如何決定「拉德瑞洛地熱場現代化」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Larderello Geothermal Field Modernization”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 地熱是品位偏低的熱源：高溫熱儲約 200 至 350 °C，中低溫只有 100 至 180 °C。熱機效率的卡諾上限由熱源與冷源的絕對溫度決定，因此地熱電廠的熱效率遠低於燃氣或燃煤電廠，閃發式約 10% 至 20%，雙循環約 8% 至 13%。效率雖低，熱源卻不花燃料費且全天候供應，容量因數常超過 90%；真正的成本在鑽井與資源風險。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Geothermal heat is of modest grade: high-temperature reservoirs are about 200–350 °C and medium to low ones only 100–180 °C. The Carnot ceiling depends on the absolute temperatures of source and sink, so geothermal plants have much lower thermal efficiency than gas or coal plants, about 10–20% for flash and 8–13% for binary. Low efficiency notwithstanding, the heat costs no fuel and is available round the clock, with capacity factors often above 90%; the real cost lies in drilling and resource risk. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：1904 年以地熱蒸汽驅動的發電機點亮了 5 顆燈泡
steps.observationEn: Project file: In 1904 a generator driven by geothermal steam lit 5 lamps
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地熱電廠效率只有一成多，所以是一種浪費的發電方式。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Geothermal plants are only a little over 10% efficient, so they are a wasteful way to generate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「熱源溫度與效率上限」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Geothermal heat is of modest grade: high-temperature reservoirs are about 200–350 °C and medium to low ones only 100–180 °C. The Carnot ceiling depends on the absolute temperatures of source and sink, so geothermal plants have much lower thermal efficiency than gas or coal plants, about 10–20% for flash and 8–13% for binary. Low efficiency notwithstanding, the heat costs no fuel and is available round the clock, with capacity factors often above 90%; the real cost lies in drilling and resource risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地熱電廠效率只有一成多，所以是一種浪費的發電方式。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Geothermal plants are only a little over 10% efficient, so they are a wasteful way to generate. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 1904 年以地熱蒸汽驅動的發電機點亮了 5 顆燈泡
knowledge.textEn: In 1904 a generator driven by geothermal steam lit 5 lamps

quiz.question: 依「熱源溫度與效率上限」的模型 η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h，以熱儲溫度為熱源、30 °C 為冷源的卡諾效率最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h for "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling", which value is closest to the carnot efficiency with the reservoir temperature as source and 30 °C as sink?
quiz.explanation: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tres = 250 °C，得 42.1 %（以熱儲溫度為熱源、30 °C 為冷源的卡諾效率）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tres = 250 °C the result is 42.1 % (carnot efficiency with the reservoir temperature as source and 30 °C as sink). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與效率上限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱源溫度與效率上限」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tres = 250 °C，得 42.1 %（以熱儲溫度為熱源、30 °C 為冷源的卡諾效率）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Tres 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tres = 250 °C the result is 42.1 % (carnot efficiency with the reservoir temperature as source and 30 °C as sink). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Tres by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Tres 增加 10% 時，結果變為 44.7 %（+6.3%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Tres by 10% changes the result to 44.7 % (+6.3%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 42.1 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Tres 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 42.1 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Tres with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tres = 250 °C，得 42.1 %（以熱儲溫度為熱源、30 °C 為冷源的卡諾效率）。
knowledge.textEn: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tres = 250 °C the result is 42.1 % (carnot efficiency with the reservoir temperature as source and 30 °C as sink).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Tres 增加 10% 時，結果變為 44.7 %（+6.3%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Tres by 10% changes the result to 44.7 % (+6.3%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱源溫度與效率上限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
回注只是把廢水處理掉，注到哪裡都一樣。
以井下溫度測錄與地球化學溫標（矽、鈉鉀鈣）交叉確認熱儲溫度，並以電廠熱平衡試驗求實際的熱效率與利用效率（對可用能）。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Reinjection is just waste-water disposal and it does not matter where the water goes.

Cross-check reservoir temperature with downhole temperature logs and chemical geothermometers (silica, Na-K-Ca), and obtain actual thermal and utilisation (exergy) efficiency from a plant heat-balance test.
quiz.explanation: 以井下溫度測錄與地球化學溫標（矽、鈉鉀鈣）交叉確認熱儲溫度，並以電廠熱平衡試驗求實際的熱效率與利用效率（對可用能）。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check reservoir temperature with downhole temperature logs and chemical geothermometers (silica, Na-K-Ca), and obtain actual thermal and utilisation (exergy) efficiency from a plant heat-balance test. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與效率上限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「熱源溫度與效率上限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以井下溫度測錄與地球化學溫標（矽、鈉鉀鈣）交叉確認熱儲溫度，並以電廠熱平衡試驗求實際的熱效率與利用效率（對可用能）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check reservoir temperature with downhole temperature logs and chemical geothermometers (silica, Na-K-Ca), and obtain actual thermal and utilisation (exergy) efficiency from a plant heat-balance test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：可行性報告要同時列出熱效率與利用效率，並說明寄生負載（泵、風扇、抽氣）占毛出力的比例。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Feasibility reports should give both thermal and utilisation efficiency and state parasitic load from pumps, fans and gas extraction as a share of gross output.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以井口溫度而非分離後進入汽輪機的蒸汽條件估算，或忽略不凝結氣體與寄生負載，預估出力會明顯高於實際淨出力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Estimating from wellhead temperature rather than steam conditions at turbine inlet after separation, or ignoring non-condensable gas and parasitic load, puts predicted output well above actual net output. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以井下溫度測錄與地球化學溫標（矽、鈉鉀鈣）交叉確認熱儲溫度，並以電廠熱平衡試驗求實際的熱效率與利用效率（對可用能）。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check reservoir temperature with downhole temperature logs and chemical geothermometers (silica, Na-K-Ca), and obtain actual thermal and utilisation (exergy) efficiency from a plant heat-balance test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 可行性報告要同時列出熱效率與利用效率，並說明寄生負載（泵、風扇、抽氣）占毛出力的比例。
knowledge.textEn: Feasibility reports should give both thermal and utilisation efficiency and state parasitic load from pumps, fans and gas extraction as a share of gross output.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：ESMAP 地熱手冊：規劃與融資。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: ESMAP Geothermal Handbook: Planning and Financing Power Generation. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「熱源溫度與效率上限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若以井口溫度而非分離後進入汽輪機的蒸汽條件估算，或忽略不凝結氣體與寄生負載，預估出力會明顯高於實際淨出力。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
只要鑽得夠深，任何地方都能便宜地開發地熱發電。
optionsEn: Estimating from wellhead temperature rather than steam conditions at turbine inlet after separation, or ignoring non-condensable gas and parasitic load, puts predicted output well above actual net output.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Drill deep enough and geothermal power can be developed cheaply anywhere.
quiz.explanation: 若以井口溫度而非分離後進入汽輪機的蒸汽條件估算，或忽略不凝結氣體與寄生負載，預估出力會明顯高於實際淨出力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimating from wellhead temperature rather than steam conditions at turbine inlet after separation, or ignoring non-condensable gas and parasitic load, puts predicted output well above actual net output. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與效率上限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱源溫度與效率上限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以井口溫度而非分離後進入汽輪機的蒸汽條件估算，或忽略不凝結氣體與寄生負載，預估出力會明顯高於實際淨出力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「拉德瑞洛地熱場現代化」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Estimating from wellhead temperature rather than steam conditions at turbine inlet after separation, or ignoring non-condensable gas and parasitic load, puts predicted output well above actual net output. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Larderello Geothermal Field Modernization”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：效率雖低，熱源卻不花燃料費且全天候供應，容量因數常超過 90%；真正的成本在鑽井與資源風險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Low efficiency notwithstanding, the heat costs no fuel and is available round the clock, with capacity factors often above 90%; the real cost lies in drilling and resource risk.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地熱電廠效率只有一成多，所以是一種浪費的發電方式。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Geothermal plants are only a little over 10% efficient, so they are a wasteful way to generate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以井口溫度而非分離後進入汽輪機的蒸汽條件估算，或忽略不凝結氣體與寄生負載，預估出力會明顯高於實際淨出力。
knowledge.textEn: Estimating from wellhead temperature rather than steam conditions at turbine inlet after separation, or ignoring non-condensable gas and parasitic load, puts predicted output well above actual net output.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表

quiz.question: 關於「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" is correct?
options: 只要鑽得夠深，任何地方都能便宜地開發地熱發電。
每一座地熱電廠都必須從頭量身訂做。
地球內部的熱不斷向地表傳導，一般大陸地殼的地溫梯度約為每公里 25 至 30 °C。
optionsEn: Drill deep enough and geothermal power can be developed cheaply anywhere.
Every geothermal plant must be designed from scratch.
Heat flows continuously from Earth's interior to the surface, and the gradient in ordinary continental crust is about 25–30 °C per kilometre.
quiz.explanation: 地球內部的熱不斷向地表傳導，一般大陸地殼的地溫梯度約為每公里 25 至 30 °C；在板塊邊界、火山帶與裂谷，岩漿或深循環熱水把高溫帶到淺處，梯度可達每公里 100 °C 以上，這些地方才是傳統地熱電廠的所在。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Heat flows continuously from Earth's interior to the surface, and the gradient in ordinary continental crust is about 25–30 °C per kilometre; at plate boundaries, volcanic belts and rifts, magma or deeply circulating water brings high temperature near the surface, with gradients above 100 °C per kilometre, and that is where conventional geothermal plants stand. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地溫梯度與鑽井深度：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Geothermal gradient and drilling depth: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」如何決定「拉德瑞洛地熱場現代化」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Geothermal gradient and drilling depth” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Larderello Geothermal Field Modernization”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 地球內部的熱不斷向地表傳導，一般大陸地殼的地溫梯度約為每公里 25 至 30 °C；在板塊邊界、火山帶與裂谷，岩漿或深循環熱水把高溫帶到淺處，梯度可達每公里 100 °C 以上，這些地方才是傳統地熱電廠的所在。鑽井成本隨深度超線性增加，所以同樣要取得 200 °C 的熱，高梯度場址只需鑽兩公里，一般地區則要六、七公里，這正是增強型地熱系統要克服的經濟門檻。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Heat flows continuously from Earth's interior to the surface, and the gradient in ordinary continental crust is about 25–30 °C per kilometre; at plate boundaries, volcanic belts and rifts, magma or deeply circulating water brings high temperature near the surface, with gradients above 100 °C per kilometre, and that is where conventional geothermal plants stand. Drilling cost grows faster than depth, so reaching 200 °C takes two kilometres at a high-gradient site but six or seven elsewhere, the economic threshold enhanced geothermal systems must overcome. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：1913 年第一座 250 kW 的商用地熱電廠啟用
steps.observationEn: Project file: The first commercial geothermal plant of 250 kW opened in 1913
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要鑽得夠深，任何地方都能便宜地開發地熱發電。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

quiz.question: 依「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」的模型 z = (T − T₀) / G，達到熱儲溫度所需的深度（地溫梯度為代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model z = (T − T₀) / G for "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth", which value is closest to the depth needed to reach the reservoir temperature (representative gradient)?
quiz.explanation: z = (T − T₀) / G；代入 Tres = 250 °C、G = 100 °C/km，得 2.35 km（達到熱儲溫度所需的深度（地溫梯度為代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: z = (T − T₀) / G; with Tres = 250 °C, G = 100 °C/km the result is 2.35 km (depth needed to reach the reservoir temperature (representative gradient)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 地溫梯度與鑽井深度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Geothermal gradient and drilling depth: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Geothermal gradient and drilling depth” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：z = (T − T₀) / G；代入 Tres = 250 °C、G = 100 °C/km，得 2.35 km（達到熱儲溫度所需的深度（地溫梯度為代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 G 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: z = (T − T₀) / G; with Tres = 250 °C, G = 100 °C/km the result is 2.35 km (depth needed to reach the reservoir temperature (representative gradient)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise G by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：G 增加 10% 時，結果變為 2.14 km（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising G by 10% changes the result to 2.14 km (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 2.35 km（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 G 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 2.35 km (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in G with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: z = (T − T₀) / G；代入 Tres = 250 °C、G = 100 °C/km，得 2.35 km（達到熱儲溫度所需的深度（地溫梯度為代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: z = (T − T₀) / G; with Tres = 250 °C, G = 100 °C/km the result is 2.35 km (depth needed to reach the reservoir temperature (representative gradient)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: G 增加 10% 時，結果變為 2.14 km（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising G by 10% changes the result to 2.14 km (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以淺層溫度梯度井、大地電磁（MT）探測的低電阻蓋層與探勘井的井溫測錄，逐步確認高溫區的範圍與深度。
地熱是乾淨的能源，不會排放任何污染物。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Confirm the extent and depth of the hot zone step by step with shallow gradient wells, the low-resistivity clay cap seen by magnetotellurics and temperature logs in exploration wells.
Geothermal is clean energy and emits no pollutants.
quiz.explanation: 以淺層溫度梯度井、大地電磁（MT）探測的低電阻蓋層與探勘井的井溫測錄，逐步確認高溫區的範圍與深度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm the extent and depth of the hot zone step by step with shallow gradient wells, the low-resistivity clay cap seen by magnetotellurics and temperature logs in exploration wells. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地溫梯度與鑽井深度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Geothermal gradient and drilling depth: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Geothermal gradient and drilling depth” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以淺層溫度梯度井、大地電磁（MT）探測的低電阻蓋層與探勘井的井溫測錄，逐步確認高溫區的範圍與深度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm the extent and depth of the hot zone step by step with shallow gradient wells, the low-resistivity clay cap seen by magnetotellurics and temperature logs in exploration wells. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：探勘井的選址要綜合地質、地球化學與地球物理三種獨立證據，並以機率分布而非單一數值呈現資源量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Site exploration wells from three independent lines of evidence — geology, geochemistry and geophysics — and present resource size as a probability distribution, not a single number.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把淺井量到的高梯度直接外推到深部，可能高估溫度：熱液對流區內溫度隨深度幾乎不變，梯度只在蓋層內才陡。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extrapolating a high gradient from shallow wells to depth may overestimate temperature: inside a convecting hydrothermal zone temperature barely changes with depth, and the gradient is steep only in the cap. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
